Here is a table of the top 10 holdings of the Nasdaq 100 Index. 

***Disclaimer:** Market capitalizations, P/E ratios, and index weightings fluctuate daily based on market conditions. The data below is an approximation based on market data as of **late May 2024**. Trailing P/E (Price-to-Earnings) ratios are used.*

| Rank | Company (Ticker) | Approx. Index Weight | Market Cap | P/E Ratio (Trailing) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **1** | Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) | ~8.6% | $3.19 Trillion | 36.5x |
| **2** | Apple Inc. (AAPL) | ~7.8% | $2.91 Trillion | 29.2x |
| **3** | NVIDIA Corp. (NVDA) | ~7.7% | $2.80 Trillion | 65.4x |
| **4** | Amazon.com Inc. (AMZN) | ~5.3% | $1.89 Trillion | 51.6x |
| **5** | Meta Platforms Inc. (META) | ~4.4% | $1.21 Trillion | 27.9x |
| **6** | Alphabet Inc. Class A (GOOGL)* | ~2.5% | $2.15 Trillion | 26.2x |
| **7** | Alphabet Inc. Class C (GOOG)* | ~2.4% | $2.15 Trillion | 26.3x |
| **8** | Broadcom Inc. (AVGO) | ~4.3% | $660 Billion | 53.8x |
| **9** | Tesla Inc. (TSLA) | ~2.4% | $560 Billion | 43.1x |
| **10** | Costco Wholesale (COST) | ~2.3% | $360 Billion | 52.4x |

*(Note: Alphabet/Google has two share classes inside the Nasdaq 100, which are tracked separately in the top 10. Their market cap represents the total combined value of the company, but their index weights are separated by share class.)*

### Key Takeaways:
* **Heavy Concentration:** The top 10 holdings make up nearly **48%** of the entire Nasdaq 100 index, meaning the performance of these specific tech giants dictates the direction of the index.
* **P/E Ratios:** Companies like Nvidia and Amazon command high earnings multiples due to immense growth expectations (AI and cloud infrastructure), whereas established giants like Alphabet and Meta trade at relatively lower multiples.
